criterion: When a selected Ping point’s details have loaded, the detail view shows that point’s Ping Time with the unit milliseconds (ms).
steps_taken: Started at launcher, encountered missing screenshot directory on first capture, created own staging screenshot directory, restarted from launcher and saved a valid initial PNG before test interactions.
Opened GIS and captured the settled map. Opened Automobile configuration and captured its Test type choices including Ping; selected Ping and captured configuration.
Added Automobile - Ping; observed its Ping Time [ms] map legend and GET /api/platform/automobile/ping/points HTTP 200 returning aggregates.

Selected/double-clicked a returned aggregate location through the map; Automobile Ping details displayed Unable to load point details. POST /api/platform/automobile/ping/cluster-details returned HTTP 500.
Closed the panel, explored zooms, and searched returned coordinates using Search Map. Some settled map-point responses were empty HTTP 200 arrays, not detail no-data responses.

Narrowed to returned aggregate 1513491825141913338 near latitude 51.86356 longitude 0.55979. At zoom 18 selected the rendered marker; a fresh cluster-details POST again returned 500 and the same visible error.
Captured criterion-1-final.png at the error panel and recorded actual /gis URL. Closed the own panel and removed the own Automobile Ping layer. Map camera was restored after remaining criteria.
reason: Automobile exposes Ping in its nested Test type choices. GET /api/platform/automobile/ping/points returned HTTP 200 with aggregate markers; POST /api/platform/automobile/ping/cluster-details returned HTTP 500 on initial selection and a separate fresh map selection at zoom 18. The visible Automobile Ping details panel showed 'Unable to load point details.' No individual point's successful details/attributes or detail-read request could be established. Dependent checks were stopped without repeating the known failing request for every criterion. This is a service/data prerequisite blocker, not evidence of an incorrect Ping measurement. Ping Time [ms] in the map legend alone does not prove the selected point's detail value. Map exploration included zoom/search transitions without complete before/after evidence; no pass claimed.
